a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate in round 1. Heads up: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan is very risky for both of us. Still, I won't take early unless we both openly agree to change the plan. Please tell me your intended action honestly.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
